## Parity — FAIL

`make test-parity` exits2:366 pass/two fail/368 tests/four files. Raw `parity.log:104–108` records two compiler children with code:null and explicit SIGSEGV, not application or Vitest-worker exits:

1. `openrouter-images-public.ts`: `/usr/local/bin/node --no-maglev /app/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node openrouter-images-public.ts`; success helper115, caller2534. Source ordering stops before writing/executing `openrouter-images-public.mjs`.
2. `openai-mixed-public.ts`: the same compiler/flags with that filename; helper115, caller2991. Source ordering stops before writing/executing `openai-mixed-public.mjs`.

Both diagnostics are `expected null to be +0`; compiler stdout/stderr in the assertion are empty. Causes are unknown. Compiler terminations alone establish no application regression and do not waive the required failed gate. No unchanged retry, compiler/runtime/debugger/collector expansion, changed flags, weakened assertions or older-source gate substitution is proposed. The independent canonical root was already admitted once by the source-local driver, not as a parity retry.

## Root — FAIL

`make test` exits2:8,656 pass/three fail/8,659 tests/526 files. Raw `root.log:104–111` records three direct children with code:null and explicit SIGSEGV. They are not all compiler failures:

1. Actual Node application probe: `node <consumer>/mcp-inheritance-installed.mjs <mode>`, failing assertion `installed-executable.test.ts:397`. The installed scenario iterates command/core/print/json/rpc, but the retained failure does not identify which iteration or internal stage crashed. The raw log establishes SIGSEGV of that directly launched Node probe, not a compiler, Vitest worker or a diagnosed nested CLI crash. The assertion's stderr diagnostic is empty; stdout is not printed there and its JSON assertion is unreached, so no empty-stdout claim is made. Later `inheritance-public.ts` compilation is unreached. Cause unknown; the intended installed MCP behavior is not qualified by this failed case.
2. `cloudflare-mixed-public.ts`: `/usr/local/bin/node --no-maglev /app/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node cloudflare-mixed-public.ts`; helper115/caller3054. Compiler SIGSEGV before its `.mjs` runtime probe.
3. `groq-public.ts`: same compiler/flags, helper115/caller3326. Compiler SIGSEGV before its `.mjs` runtime probe.

All three fail `expected null to be +0`; the two compiler assertion channels are empty. Internal causes remain unknown. In particular the actual application crash is not explained away by separate compiler terminations. Required root remains failed. Owning Bedrock and its installed consumer pass within this same root, but do not repair it or older Google/E16 application crashes.
